summary: Regression test of 3 refactored pages (CommunityPage/PlaybooksPage/ChatPage) after split into sub-components. All critical data-testids preserved, UI flows work identically to iteration_64. Zero regressions. Backend skipped per request.
critical_code_review_comments: CommunityPage.js (153 lines), PlaybooksPage.js (196 lines), ChatPage.js (192 lines) — all within target sizes. Clean separation of concerns: orchestrator handles state+API calls, sub-components receive props. No logic duplicated across files.
ChatPage.js has a buildFullMessage helper extracted at module level — good pattern. Consider moving it to a separate chatHelpers.js if it grows.
PlaybooksPage.js sendMessage() still inlines the next-step transition with setTimeout(600ms). Not a regression, but could be moved into a usePlaybookChat hook for even cleaner separation.
CommunityPage.js prop-drills commentDraft/setCommentDraft through CommunityPost. Acceptable for now, but if community grows, consider lifting comments into a useCommunityPosts hook.
test_credentials: standard@wladbot.test / test123 (primary), free@wladbot.test / test123 (for upsell-mini-btn visibility which only shows for non-premium users)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 65 = pure refactor regression. All 3 pages verified via Playwright. IMPORTANT testid naming reminders for future testers: Community filter testids are SINGULAR: filter-all, filter-win, filter-question, filter-challenge, filter-general (NOT filter-wins/filter-questions).
